{{Top|leg}}
'''Bodrite''' was a fine [[Marble/Legends|marbleized]] rock found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bodrin]] and quarried there by [[Elrood Quarry Corporation]]. Bodrite was in demand throughout the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. The rock was used in floors and walls for elaborate palaces, expensive office complexes, and other ornate buildings. The bodrite was hard to quarry, but only about two thousand [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of the rock per year were necessary to maintain the small planet's trade balance.
